`29-29`: _🗄️ Data Integrity & Integration_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _🏗️ Heavy lift_ **Add a Redis Cluster routing test.** `newTestStore` always creates a standalone `redis.NewClient`. These tests cannot enable `useReadOnly` or `routeByLatency`, or validate cleanup during replica lag. Add a primary-replica cluster test. Verify that a replica-side `GET` miss does not remove the directory index member when the master still has the value.
